fusions.name: Gnaw
fusions.desc: Bites a mouthful out of the target for 9 damage, leaving it 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds, and you heal for 25% of the damage dealt. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Ruminant Belch
fusions.desc: Belches in a 4-tile cone, dealing 12 poison damage to everything caught. Your afflictions on each one spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Clean Plate
fusions.desc: Eats from every body within 9 tiles, up to 5; each gives back 7% of your health.

fusions.name: Second Helpings
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, 15% of the damage you deal heals you for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
